sidePanel.title: Workspace
sidePanel.subtitle: Pick a tool on the left to draw, or select a shape on the map to edit it.
sidePanel.info: Changes apply to the currently selected rack. Use the toolbar to draw new shapes on the map.
sidePanel.drawHint: Click once to set the first corner, then click again to set the opposite corner.
sidePanel.levelHeightHint: Vertical spacing between shelves. Each level extrudes from base+L×height to base+(L+1)×height.
sidePanel.levelGapHint: Vertical air between shelves. Each shelf stays levelHeight tall; the gap is empty space between levels.
sidePanel.binSelectedHint: Cell r{{row}} · c{{col}}{{levelSuffix}} ready to edit.
sidePanel.binPickHint: Click a cell on the map to choose which bin to edit.
sidePanel.drawHintCommit: Move the mouse to position the second corner — a live preview will follow — then click to commit.
sidePanel.drawHintIdle: Enable drawing mode to start a new rack.
sidePanel.saveHint: Click on the map to draw; the second click saves the rack.
sidePanel.moveHint: Drag the shape on the map to reposition it. Press Esc to cancel.
sidePanel.rotateHint: Drag a corner handle to rotate. Press Esc to cancel.
sidePanel.confirmDeleteHint: Click again to confirm deletion. This action can be undone with Ctrl/Cmd+Z.
sidePanel.confirmDeleteAllHint: Click again to confirm deletion of {{count}} racks. This action can be undone with Ctrl/Cmd+Z.
sidePanel.bulkSelectedSubtitle: Bulk-edit applies to all selected racks.
sidePanel.confirmDeleteZone: Delete facility "{{name}}"? Shapes in this facility will become unassigned.
sidePanel.zonesEmpty: No facilities yet. Create one to group your racks and assets.
sidePanel.receiveShadowsHint: Let shadows from taller shapes darken this surface. Enable on floor slabs. May darken at low zoom.
sidePanel.emptyHint: Draw your first rack on the map. Click once to set a corner, then click again to commit.
sidePanel.markerPlacementSubtitle: Click on the map to drop one. Esc exits.
sidePanel.markerPlacementHint: Click anywhere on the map to drop an asset. Stay in this mode to keep placing — switch tools or press Esc to stop.
sidePanel.markerPoleHint: Visual stick from the asset down toward its ground anchor. Only visible when elevation > 0.
sidePanel.circlePlacementSubtitleSingle: Click and drag to draw. Esc cancels.
sidePanel.circlePlacementSubtitleGrid: Click twice to set opposite corners. Esc cancels.
sidePanel.circlePlacementHintSingle: Press and hold the mouse to start a circle, drag outward to size it, release to commit.
sidePanel.circlePlacementHintGrid: Click once for the first corner, then click again for the opposite corner. Each cell gets a circle inscribed in it.
sidePanel.circleCellRadiusHint: Inscribed in each cell. Capped at half the cell size.
sidePanel.polygonPlacementSubtitleEmpty: Click on the map to add the first vertex. Esc cancels.
sidePanel.polygonPlacementSubtitlePartial_one: {{count}} vertex — at least 3 needed to commit.
sidePanel.polygonPlacementSubtitlePartial_other: {{count}} vertices — at least 3 needed to commit.
sidePanel.polygonPlacementSubtitleReady: {{count}} vertices — double-click or Enter to commit.
sidePanel.polygonPlacementHint: Click to add vertices. Double-click or press Enter to commit. Backspace removes the last vertex. Esc cancels.
sidePanel.magicWallHint: Click one or more areas on the map to select them, then Generate to spawn walls around each. Shared edges between adjacent areas become a single party wall; segments already covered by an existing wall are skipped.
sidePanel.magicWallSubtitleEmpty: Click an area on the map to select it.
sidePanel.linePlacementSubtitleEmpty: Click on the map to add the first point. Esc cancels.
sidePanel.linePlacementSubtitlePartial: {{count}} point — click again to add the next.
sidePanel.linePlacementSubtitleReady: {{count}} points — double-click or Enter to commit.
sidePanel.linePlacementHint: Click to add points. Double-click or press Enter to commit. Backspace removes the last point. Esc cancels.
sidePanel.lineWallHint: When > 0, the line extrudes upward as a wall. Combine with elevation to lift it off the ground.
sidePanel.imagePlacementSubtitleEmpty: Upload an image or a PDF drawing sheet.
sidePanel.imagePlacementSubtitleReady: Click and drag on the map to draw the floor-plan bounds.
sidePanel.imagePlacementSubtitleScaled: Drag on the map to position the sheet — its size is fixed by the drawing scale.
sidePanel.imagePlacementHint: Pick a file, then click and drag on the map to draw a bounding box. Release the mouse to place. Press Esc to cancel an in-flight drag or exit the tool.
sidePanel.imagePlacementHintScaled: Drag on the map to position the sheet. Its size is fixed by the drawing scale, so only the location follows your drag. Press Esc to cancel an in-flight drag or exit the tool.
sidePanel.imageUploadHint: PNG, JPEG, GIF, or a PDF drawing · a scaled PDF places at its true size.
sidePanel.imageFromPdfTitle: Rasterized from a PDF drawing sheet
sidePanel.imageNoScale: No scale set — drag to size it.
sidePanel.imageCropHint: Trim from each edge as a percentage of the full image. Non-destructive — the original file is preserved.
sidePanel.scaleHint: Drag the corner handle to scale the image around its center. Press Esc to cancel.
sidePanel.gridScaleHint: Drag the corner handle to resize the rack. Hold Shift for uniform scale.
sidePanel.doorScaleHint: Drag the orange dot to resize the opening. Press Esc to cancel.
sidePanel.layersHint: Drag to reorder. Top of the list draws on top of the map.
sidePanel.graphicsShadowsHint: Realistic wall & rack shadows. Higher GPU cost.
sidePanel.graphicsAOHint: Soft shading in corners. Screen-space GPU pass.
sidePanel.graphicsMarkerOcclusionHint: Markers behind a floor plan are hidden, like real 3D geometry.
sidePanel.geometryLockedHint: This shape has bins linked to external data. Scale and redraw are disabled to keep row/col addresses stable. Move and rotate remain available.
sidePanel.modelPlacementSubtitle: Click on the map to place a 3D model.
sidePanel.textAlignMapHint: The label rotates with the map.
sidePanel.textAlignViewportHint: The label always faces the camera.
sidePanel.textEmissiveHint: Higher values let the label glow through dim basemaps.
sidePanel.textOcclusionHint: Hide the label when 3D geometry covers it.
sidePanel.textPlacementHint: Click on the map to drop a text label.
sidePanel.textPlacementSubtitle: Click on the map to drop a label.
sidePanel.textPresetHint: Sets size, weight, color and halo to a curated combination.
sidePanel.textRotationHint: Rotate the label around its anchor.
sidePanel.textSizeMode_screen_hint: Default. Shrinks a bit at low zoom so dense facilities don’t become walls of text.
sidePanel.textSizeMode_fixed_hint: Always the authored pixel size on screen — never scales with zoom.
sidePanel.textSizeMode_shape_hint: Scales with the map so the label stays inside its shape as you zoom out.
sidePanel.textSizeModeHint: “In shape” makes the label scale with the map so it stays inside its container as you zoom out.
sidePanel.stairPlacementHintStart: Click the bottom of the run to begin.
sidePanel.stairPlacementHintEnd: Click the top of the run to place the stairs.
sidePanel.stairSelectedNote: Changes apply to this one only. Use the toolbar to draw another.
sidePanel.stairTreadAutoHint: Tread depth follows the drag length
sidePanel.stairTreadManualHint: Tread depth fixed; top anchor recomputes
sidePanel.stairTypeHintStraight: Click bottom, then top of the run.
sidePanel.stairTypeHintL: Click bottom, corner, then top. Each flight uses the full step count.
sidePanel.stairTypeHintU: Click bottom, then top of flight 1. Flight 2 mirrors back at the same length.
sidePanel.stairPlacementHintCorner: Click the corner where the run turns.
sidePanel.stairLandingDepthHint: Depth of the turn platform along the run direction.
sidePanel.stairFlightGapHint: Central void between the two flights. Set to 0 for flush flights.

sidePanel.doorSelectedNote: Changes apply to this door only. Use the toolbar to draw another.

lift.inclineTooSteep: Steeper than 35° — not allowed for escalators. Lengthen the run.
lift.inclineSteep: Over 30° is only allowed up to 6 m rise. Lengthen the run or lower the angle.
lift.inclineShallow: Unusually shallow (under 27°). Standard escalators run at 30°.
lift.layoutPairHint: The second unit sits to the right and runs the other way.
lift.linkedHint: Heights follow the linked floors — moving a floor plan up or down moves the escalator with it.
lift.noFloorsHint: Add a floor plan for each level to link them. Until then, set the heights below.
lift.unlinkedHint: Pick both floors to link the heights, or set them below.
lift.inclineFitHint: On: the drawn line sets the direction and the length follows the rise. Off: the drawn length is used.
lift.animatedHint: Animates the treads in the travel direction. Keeps the map redrawing while visible; off when your system asks for reduced motion.
lift.servedHint: Doors open on each ticked floor and the shaft runs from the lowest to above the highest.
lift.servedNoneHint: Tick the floors this lift serves, or set the stops by hand below.
lift.depthHint: Measured back from the door side you drew.
lift.label: Label
lift.placeEscalatorStart: Click the bottom landing of the escalator.
lift.placeEscalatorEnd: Click towards the top landing. With “Fit length to incline” on, the length follows the rise.
lift.placeElevatorStart: Standing in front of the lift, click the left corner of the door side.
lift.placeElevatorEnd: Click the right corner. The shaft extends back from this line.
lift.lengthHint: Total footprint, landings included. Changing it uses this length and lets the incline follow.
lift.landingLengthHint: Flat run at each end before the incline (typically 1–2.5 m).
lift.stepEdgeHint: Safety line along each step. Set the width to 0 to remove it.
lift.sizeHint: Shrinks the car, doors and the shaft above the top floor. For buildings drawn smaller than real size.

sidePanel.graphicsLiftIconsHint: Escalator and elevator icons and labels on the map.
sidePanel.graphicsFloorBaseHint: Fills the space under an upper floor shown on its own.
sidePanel.imageClipToWallsHint: Hides the sheet margin, title block and dimensions around the outer walls of this floor. Draw the outer walls first. The image itself is not changed.
sidePanel.solidObjectHint: Render as a solid block, lit like walls — for counters, plinths, partitions, machines. Makes it opaque and gives a flat shape a height.
sidePanel.graphicsOcclusionGhosts: Show hidden items as faint ghosts
sidePanel.graphicsOcclusionGhostsHint: Markers, labels and live data hidden behind floors or walls stay faintly visible. Click one to show it.
sidePanel.floorShapesHide: Hide shapes on this floor (keep the plan)
sidePanel.pathRowRiseHint: Each row sits this much higher than the one in front — raked seating such as stadium stands or a lecture theatre.
sidePanel.pathSmoothHint: Join the clicked points with a curve instead of straight lines.
sidePanel.pathHint: Cells run along the path; rows sit across it. Draw seat rows, U-shaped or bent racks.
sidePanel.drawHintPath: Click to add points along the path. Double-click or press Enter to finish; Backspace removes the last point.
sidePanel.wallLeanHint: Moves the top of the wall sideways. A closed loop with a curved lean makes a stadium roof or a bowl.
sidePanel.topShapeHint: Taper narrows straight to the top (pyramid, cone); Dome curves in. Raise Top size to cut it off flat.

apiReference.description: Every table gets these 12 endpoints automatically. Authenticate with the table’s bearer token — one token, one table. Rate-limited per token (default 60 req/min, burst 30).
apiReference.insertSingle: Insert or update a single row (upsert by entityKey).

apiReference.getOne: Get a single row by entityKey.
apiReference.patchOne: Partial update — only the keys you send are merged onto the existing payload.
apiReference.deleteOne: Delete a single row by entityKey.
apiReference.patchBulk: Patch up to 1000 rows by key list. Single transaction, partial-success.
apiReference.patchByFilter: Patch every row matching a filter. Cap 5000 rows per call (413 if exceeded).
apiReference.deleteBulk: Delete up to 1000 rows by key list.
apiReference.deleteByFilter: Delete every row matching a filter. Cap 5000 rows per call (413 if exceeded).

measure.angleLockTitle: Snap each segment to the floor plan's angles (hold Shift to flip)
measure.labelsTitle: Show lengths and areas on drawings and guides
measure.clearGuidesTitle: Delete every guide on this floor
measure.hidePlan: Hide floor plan images to compare with your drawing
measure.barHint: Type a length and press Enter to place the next point exactly · hold Shift to flip the angle lock

cal.startTitle: Set the plan's real size from room areas or known lengths
cal.title: Calibrate floor plan
cal.areaFirst: Click one corner of a room whose area is printed on the plan.
cal.areaSecond: Now click the opposite corner of that room.
cal.lengthFirst: Click one end of a dimension you know (a wall, a door, a grid line).
cal.straightenFirst: Click one end of a wall that should run straight across or straight up the plan.
cal.straightenSecond: Click the other end of that wall — the plan turns to make it straight.
cal.marksHint: Plans are rarely exact. Untick marks that disagree a lot with the others, then apply.
cal.noMarks: Add at least one mark to work out the scale.
cal.centerHint: Type the plan's known centre (or paste "lat, lng" into latitude). Size changes keep this point fixed.

exportDialog.formatGlbHint: Walls, areas, racks, stairs, doors, models and floor plans as one 3D file with the data attached. Opens in Blender, Unity, Windows 3D Viewer.
exportDialog.previewGlb: Will build a 3D model of {{count}} shape(s). Large floors with many models can take a moment.
